{{Top|leg}}
'''Cellulose''' was an organic compound eaten by some [[Species/Legends|species]], and indigestible to others. Both [[drapsha]] and [[spetzna]] were dishes with a cellulose base to cater to those beings who could assimilate it.<ref name="RM">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> [[Solid Fuel Converter]]s could convert cellulose into power for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]].<ref name="GG6-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
